name: register-zapier-partner-lead

trigger.trigger_note: Notion DB automation on the Companies data source (21991b07-11ac-80b0-b787-000b3d3995f6, in Core CRM Objects): the 'Register Lead' button -> 'Send to webhook' -> the webhook_url above (the hooks.zapier.com catch URL, NOT the internal trigger_url). CUTOVER PENDING: the button still posts to the classic 'Register Zapier Lead' Zap; repoint it to complete the migration (see README Cutover).

tables.01KPZFHX4RP6SER3AEK4YJ62BF: Register Zapier Lead Table — client id -> Notion Company page id, plus the submission log. Read by zapier-partner-lead-status-to-notion.
tables.01JM3J9SG5X6S8GBSSC8AS28AT: User IDs — Notion user id -> Zapier partner contact id (read-only here).

partner_app.note: Solution Partner Operations Tool (private, invite-only). The classic Zap ran on 1.4.1; the bound connection's implementation_id still reads App227952CLIAPI@1.4.1 and resolves fine against 1.5.0 actions. submit_client is create-or-reuse on (partner account, client email) and does NOT update an existing client's details — which is why a repeat click is skipped in code rather than left to the tool.

description: Notion Companies 'Register Lead' button -> submit the company's Zapier account owner to the Zapier partner program as a managed-revenue client, index client id -> Notion page id in the lead Table, and stamp the client id + Submitted status back on the company record. Migration of the classic 'Register Zapier Lead' Zap.
durable_version_note: Pinned to 0.10.1 deliberately. A publish on 0.11.0 failed at run time with 'Dependency installation failed' — the durable runtime's pnpm enforces a minimum release age and 0.11.0 was under a day old (published 2026-07-27T14:58Z). Check the publish date before bumping. Version 019fa7a7-… / 019fa7a8-… are the discarded 0.11.0 publishes.
